function.name: check_setup
function.description: Validate that Career Architect is fully set up and ready to use. Always call this first before any pipeline action. Returns JSON with per-step status and a top-level 'ready' boolean.

function.name: create_application
function.description: Create a new application folder for a job and save the job description. Returns the folder path.

job_description.description: Full text of the job description

function.name: get_pipeline_context
function.description: Return the full orchestrator prompt, identity.json, and master_experience.md content needed to run the Career Architect pipeline. Feed this context to the LLM before asking it to generate documents.

function.name: write_document
function.description: Write a generated document (resume, cover letter, interview prep, etc.) to the application folder.

content.description: Full file content including YAML frontmatter

function.name: run_ats_score
function.description: Run ATS keyword scoring on an application folder. Compares resume.md against job_desc.md. Returns a score percentage and list of missing keywords. Score ≥70% is strong, 50–69% acceptable, <50% is a blocker.

function.name: build_resume
function.description: Build PDF, DOCX, and TXT artifacts from resume.md. Reads identity.json to inject the contact header. Only call this after ATS score is ≥50%.

template.description: LaTeX template. default=engineering/business, minimal=healthcare/academic, creative=design, executive=Director+

function.name: update_status
function.description: Update the status of an application in TRACKER.md.

notes.description: Optional note to add to the tracker row

function.name: list_applications
function.description: List all application folders with their status, document completeness, and ATS scores.

function.name: get_prompt
function.description: Retrieve the content of any prompt file from the .prompts/ directory. Use this to load role-specific prompts, quality gate definitions, or the main orchestrator.

function.name: rebuild_experience_lake
function.description: Rebuild master_experience.md from all source materials. Call this after the user adds new resumes or project docs to source_materials/.
